land-110m.json, countries-110m.json — world-atlas 2.0.2 (https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas, ISC licence),
TopoJSON built from Natural Earth 1:110m data (public domain, https://www.naturalearthdata.com/). Unmodified.
Used only by the opening globe intro in static/app.js (land and the South Korea outline on the MapLibre globe).
